# PolyWorks forms (VB6 fixture)

Source: https://github.com/opensoldat/polyworks, branch `develop`,
commit `2ba5b0ec60545c47ab5205b9cb34b0f5ec0d3650`, folder `src/`.

License: MIT, Copyright (c) 2006-2007 Anna Zajaczkowski and (c) 2009-present
The PolyWorks Contributors. The full text is in `LICENSE` beside this file; it
was read in full before these files were copied.

Files: `frmPreferences.frm`/`.frx` and `frmInfo.frm`/`.frx`, unchanged. Two
forms authored in Visual Basic 6 whose headers carry menus (`VB.Menu` blocks),
control arrays (`Index` properties), and ComboBox rows stored in the sidecar
(`List` and `ItemData` records). These files use LF line endings as published.

These files are test fixtures only. They are excluded from the extension
package by `.vscodeignore` (`tests/**`).
